'''Tikiar''' was a [[Mekuun Corporation/Legends|Mekuun Corporation]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

==Charatceristics==
The Tikiars were sleek, dark, two-person starfighters named after the [[Tikiarri]]. Their thrusters made unique quintuple starburst patterns.

==History==
They were used by the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] at the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Also the [[House Vandron]] used this type of starfighters. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the House Vandron used the starfighters to escort the ''[[Prominence]]'' and the [[Ecliptic (Consular-class)|''Ecliptic'']] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]]. But when the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] took over the escort, the Tikiars flew away.

During the years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], they were a favorite of the noble houses of [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]; [[House Vandron]] had a large fleet of them.
